selection_rule: Within the fixed 4030-user validation cohort, choose maximum/minimum nonzero original >=80% training-airing count; ties use ascending exact decimal user-ID string. No predictions/AP or validation behaviour beyond cohort eligibility are used.

methods.configuration: Selected rich+title TF-IDF cosine/count profile; original >=80% history and pre-May18 metadata
Unweighted strict80 weekly rules, joint>=5/confidence>=.1/lift>1, log-count query
Final007 component: 50% history, eight-week mass-preserving counts, f16/log-target/confidence1/reg1/15 epochs
Final007 component: raw graph alpha .5, eight-week 50% log-count restarts

time_policy: Half-open Europe/Kyiv boundaries; interval arithmetic UTC; full airing-duration denominator; exact >=80% truth
labels: Canonical pre-cutoff ID-level representative labels; episode titles may vary. Actual latest watched titles and schedule records are saved separately.
hits: A hit is membership anywhere in the frozen five-ID truth, not rank-aligned equality. Watched-but-outside-Top5 is not a hit.

markers.○: Qualified validation watch, outside true Top-5
markers.~: Only partial observed overlap; no >=80% watch

numerical_verification: Assistant checks only; student's personal review remains pending
experiments: Closed; report evidence only, no fitting or tuning
